name: EPIC 211590863

text.card: A red giant 4,156 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.98 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,601 K at its surface.
